text:
samir: Heads-up — running the new starterkit-rag sample and seeing duplicate upstream requests when auth retries kick in and KV prefix caching is enabled. Happens on both local edge and hosted demos.

maria: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs? :eyes:

samir: quick log snippet: `POST /v1/generate` gets 401, SDK retries, we revalidate token and send the request again, but the client-side prefix cache already wrote an in-flight marker so the model gets two identical behind-the-scenes calls.

samir: repro steps: 1) start starter (edge build) 2) hit /api/complete with expired token 3) observe two inflight requests in serving console and one returned to the app.

maria: can you paste the client request code? maybe retry handling needs idempotency header.

samir: code:```js
// simplified
const r = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/ggml-lite',
  prompt,
  retry: { max: 2, backoff: 200 }
})
```

aj: this sounds similar to the SDK parity issue we tracked — node sdk attaches an `x-idempotency-key` when retry is enabled, edge/browser client currently doesn't. so the runtime sees two separate requests.

aj: quick fix: add a short-lived idempotency key at the app layer until we ship parity. E.g., `headers: { 'x-idempotency-key': crypto.randomUUID() }` and persist while retrying.

devon: fwiw the starterkit's KV cache has an "inflight" marker keyed by the request fingerprint. If idempotency key differs across retries the marker logic treats them as separate keys. We should either include idempotency in the fingerprint or avoid regenerating the key between retries.

samir: thanks — i'll try adding header workaround. also saw an eval harness failure in CI: `evals/llama-rag/seed-embed-parity` flaky after auth retries. ci-bot shows 2 failed runs in last 2 hours.

ci-bot: deploy/system: 2 failed CI evals for branch starterkit/retry-fix. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/evals/1755 (truncated).

maria: we should create a tiny failing test in the starter's e2e that simulates expired token + retry path so we don't regress. Add to sample's `tests/retry.spec.ts`.

aj: i'll open a short PR to add idempotency header behavior to the edge client and a test. If we want a longer-term fix, we should change the cache fingerprint to include the idempotency key only when present.

devon: agree. also add a note in the starter README: "auth + retry: enable x-idempotency-key to avoid duplicate backend calls when using KV inflight markers" — saves users a head-scratch.

samir: perfect. i'll paste my temporary patch here after i test. :thumbsup:
